doc.brief: A dialog for choosing a color.
doc.md:
A dialog for choosing a color.

`GtkColorChooserDialog` implements the [`ColorChooser`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColorChooser) interface
and does not provide much API of its own.

To create a `GtkColorChooserDialog`, use [`ColorChooserDialog.new()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColorChooserDialog#constructor:new).

To change the initially selected color, use
[`ColorChooser.set_rgba()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColorChooser#method:set_rgba). To get the selected color use
[`ColorChooser.get_rgba()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColorChooser#method:get_rgba).

`GtkColorChooserDialog` has been deprecated in favor of [`ColorDialog`](xref:gtk:Gtk.ColorDialog).

## CSS nodes

`GtkColorChooserDialog` has a single CSS node with the name `window` and style
class `.colorchooser`.

show-editor.brief: Whether the color chooser dialog is showing the single-color editor.
show-editor.md:
Whether the color chooser dialog is showing the single-color editor.

It can be set to switch the color chooser into single-color editing mode.
